heading: Fifteen years of making invisible work visible.
body: Choose a chapter to see the questions, collaborations, and bodies of work that shaped it.

items.summary: Shaping enterprise AI work into explainable interfaces that let people guide, inspect, and trust the system.
details: Architected agentic AI experiences across sourcing, contracts, category, and autonomous purchase-order workflows.
Led 0 to 1 design for AI marketing and generative content products with product managers and AI engineers.
Standardized component specifications, handoff guidelines, and design QA workflows, reducing frontend rework by 75 to 85 percent.
Mentored designers and cohorts on design thinking, Figma practice, and AI-accelerated workflows.

items.summary: Turned research, client context, and complex requirements into clear product direction teams could build from.
details: Led user research, customer journey mapping, and interface design for enterprise digital solutions.
Translated interviews, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations into data-backed design recommendations.
Built structured component libraries and supported high-fidelity agile releases.

items.summary: Built a visual and interaction foundation across e-commerce and consumer software, where first impressions had to do real work.
details: Designed end-to-end web and mobile interfaces, responsive applications, and visual brand assets.
Improved onboarding and checkout journeys through wireframing, interactive prototyping, and team alignment.
